name: State Bank of India (SBI)
overview: India's largest Public Sector Bank with dedicated MSME, Mudra, Stand-Up India, and SC/ST concessional credit desks across urban and rural branches.
processing_time: 7–14 working days after complete DPR & KYC verification
collateral_policy: Collateral-free up to ₹10 lakh under PMMY/CGTMSE; Stand-Up India covered under CGSSI guarantee.
bank_required_documents: Project Report / Quotation for machinery or working capital
helpline_hours: 24x7 Toll-Free Customer Care • Branch Desk: Mon–Sat 10:00 AM – 4:00 PM (closed 2nd & 4th Sat)

name: Punjab National Bank (PNB)
overview: Leading North & Pan-India Public Sector Bank participating actively in JanSamarth, PMEGP, Stand-Up India, PM-SURAJ, and NSFDC channel lending.
collateral_policy: Zero collateral up to ₹10 lakh under Mudra & PM Vishwakarma; CGTMSE coverage for higher MSME limits.
bank_required_documents: Shop/Unit Rent Agreement or Ownership Proof

name: Bank of Baroda (BOB)
overview: Major Public Sector Bank with Baroda Swarojgar Vikas Sansthan (BSVS) entrepreneurship training & fast-track JanSamarth Mudra/Stand-Up desks.
collateral_policy: No collateral required for Mudra (up to ₹10L) and PM Vishwakarma; CGTMSE guarantee for eligible MSME units.
bank_required_documents: Project Cost Estimate & Vendor Proforma Invoice

name: Canara Bank
overview: Public Sector Bank with strong RSETI rural self-employment linkages, women SHG credit, PMEGP, and Mudra loan desks nationwide.
collateral_policy: Collateral-free up to ₹10 lakh under PMMY; guarantee coverage for Stand-Up India and PMEGP loans.
bank_required_documents: Aadhaar Card, PAN Card & Voter ID

name: Union Bank of India
overview: Pan-India Public Sector Bank offering Union Mudra, Stand-Up India, PM SVANidhi, PMEGP, and women/SC priority MSME finance.
collateral_policy: No third-party collateral for Mudra & CGTMSE-covered loans; margin money varies 0%–10% by scheme.

name: Indian Bank
overview: Public Sector Bank with strong presence across South, East, and North India supporting SHG linkages, Mudra, PMEGP, and Stand-Up India.
collateral_policy: Collateral-free micro & small enterprise credit under Mudra and CGTMSE norms.

name: Central Bank of India
overview: Public Sector Bank serving semi-urban and rural entrepreneurs under PMMY, PMEGP, Cent-Kalyani (women), and NSFDC-linked schemes.
collateral_policy: Collateral-free up to ₹10L (Mudra) and ₹1 Cr (Cent-Kalyani/CGTMSE eligible units).

name: Bank of India (BOI)
overview: Public Sector Bank offering Star Mudra, Stand-Up India, PMEGP, and Star Mahila Gold concessional enterprise credit.
collateral_policy: Zero collateral under PMMY & PM Vishwakarma; CGTMSE coverage for Stand-Up India & PMEGP.

name: Punjab & Sind Bank
overview: Public Sector Bank with strong coverage in Punjab, Haryana, Rajasthan, Delhi, and UP for agriculture, dairy, transport, and MSME loans.
collateral_policy: Collateral-free up to ₹10 lakh under PMMY; CGTMSE guarantee for eligible priority sector MSMEs.

name: UCO Bank
overview: Public Sector Bank supporting PMMY, PMEGP, Stand-Up India, and state-sponsored self-employment schemes across Eastern, Northern, and Western India.
collateral_policy: Collateral-free under PMMY and CGTMSE-backed schemes.

name: Bank of Maharashtra
overview: Public Sector Bank with deep penetration in Maharashtra and national Lead Bank responsibilities for Mudra, PMEGP, and women SHG loans.
collateral_policy: Collateral-free under Mudra/PM Vishwakarma; CGTMSE guarantee for MSME term loans.

name: Indian Overseas Bank (IOB)
overview: Public Sector Bank supporting Mudra, PMEGP, Stand-Up India, PM-SURAJ, and artisan/micro-enterprise financing.
collateral_policy: Collateral-free up to ₹10L under PMMY; CGTMSE cover available for higher limits.

name: Regional Rural Banks (RRBs / Gramin Banks)
overview: Sponsored by Public Sector Banks and State Governments to deliver rural Mudra, SHG, KCC, dairy, and artisan micro-credit in villages and tehsils.
collateral_policy: Collateral-free for Mudra, SHG-JLG, and small rural livelihood loans under RBI priority sector norms.
bank_required_documents: Aadhaar Card & Jan Dhan / Savings Passbook
Local Gram Panchayat / Ward Residence Proof
Activity Estimate / Livestock or Tool Quote

name: Rajasthan SC/ST Finance & Dev. Corp (RSFDC / ANUPEKSHA)
overview: Designated State Channelising Agency (SCA) in Rajasthan implementing NSFDC concessional schemes (MCF, MSY, TL, ELS, LVY) and state SC/ST subsidy loans.
processing_time: 15–30 working days (district committee & SCA quota approval)
collateral_policy: Hypothecation of assets created + guarantor/security norms per loan slab.
helpline_hours: Mon–Fri 9:30 AM – 6:00 PM (Rajasthan Govt Working Days)

name: UP SC Finance & Development Corporation (UPSCFDC)
overview: Official Uttar Pradesh State Channelising Agency delivering NSFDC concessional credit, Pt. Deen Dayal Upadhyay Swarojgar Yojana, and Safai Karmachari schemes.
collateral_policy: Subsidy-linked margin money up to ₹10,000–₹50,000; standard guarantor norms above ₹1 lakh.
bank_required_documents: Digital SC Caste & Income Certificate (e-District UP)

name: Punjab SC Land Dev. & Finance Corp (PSCFC / PSCLDFC)
overview: Punjab's official State Channelising Agency for NSFDC term loans, dairy/agriculture allied loans, and state SC self-employment subsidies.
collateral_policy: Direct SCA lending up to slab limit with guarantor or bank tie-up for higher term loans.

name: Delhi SC/ST/OBC/Minorities Finance Corp (DSFDC)
overview: Government of NCT of Delhi State Channelising Agency offering NSFDC/NBCFDC/NSKFDC composite loans, commercial vehicle finance, and education loans.
collateral_policy: Hypothecation of vehicle/equipment + govt servant or income-tax payee guarantor as per DSFDC slab.
bank_required_documents: Aadhaar, PAN & Delhi Residence Proof (min 5 yrs)
SC/ST/OBC Certificate issued by SDM Delhi

name: State Channelising Agencies (TAHDCO / MPBCDC / Ambedkar Corp / State SC-ST Corps)
overview: Designated State Scheduled Caste / Backward Class Finance & Development Corporations channelling NSFDC, NSKFDC, and state-level margin money schemes.
collateral_policy: Concessional state-backed guarantee and asset hypothecation per NSFDC guidelines.

name: Empanelled NBFC-MFIs (Asirvad / CreditAccess / Satin / Spandana)
overview: RBI-regulated Microfinance Institutions partnering for doorstep micro-credit, SHG/JLG group lending, and Aajeevika Microfinance Yojana (AMFY).
collateral_policy: 100% collateral-free Joint Liability Group (JLG) or SHG peer guarantee.

name: JanSamarth Portal (National Credit-Linked Govt Portal)
headquarters: Digital Portal — Ministry of Finance & MoSJE
overview: Unified Government of India digital portal connecting applicants to 200+ lender banks for Mudra, Stand-Up India, PM SVANidhi, Education, and Agri credit-linked subsidy schemes.
processing_time: Instant digital eligibility check; 7–14 days bank sanction
collateral_policy: Follows underlying scheme norms (zero collateral for Mudra & CGTMSE-eligible loans).
bank_required_documents: Bank Account & ITR / Income Details (if available)
helpline_hours: 24x7 Online Portal • Helpline: Mon–Sat 9:30 AM – 6:00 PM

name: PM-SURAJ National Portal (MoSJE)
headquarters: New Delhi — Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment
overview: Pradhan Mantri Samajik Utthan evam Rozgar Adharit Jankalyan (PM-SURAJ) national portal for direct concessional loans from NSFDC, NSKFDC, and NBCFDC.
processing_time: 10–21 working days via linked Bank / SCA
collateral_policy: Concessional interest rates (4%–6% p.a.) with capital subsidy up to ₹15,000–₹50,000 under eligible schemes.
bank_required_documents: Verified Caste Certificate (SC / OBC / Safai Karamchari)
helpline_hours: 24x7 Online Portal • MoSJE Helpline: Mon–Fri 9:30 AM – 6:00 PM

name: KVIC PMEGP e-Portal
overview: Official Ministry of MSME portal for Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP) providing 15%–35% margin money subsidy for new manufacturing & service enterprises.
collateral_policy: Mandatory 5%–10% beneficiary contribution; loans up to ₹10L (or ₹20L under CGTMSE) without third-party collateral.
helpline_hours: 24x7 Online Portal • KVIC Support: Mon–Fri 10:00 AM – 5:30 PM

name: Stand-Up Mitra Portal (SIDBI)
headquarters: Lucknow — Small Industries Development Bank of India (SIDBI)
overview: Dedicated digital handholding and bank-matching portal for SC, ST, and Women entrepreneurs setting up greenfield enterprises from ₹10 lakh to ₹1 crore.
collateral_policy: Covered under Credit Guarantee Fund for Stand-Up India (CGSSI) with composite loan up to 85% of project cost.
bank_required_documents: SC/ST Caste Certificate or Women Ownership Proof (>=51% stake)
helpline_hours: 24x7 Online Portal • SIDBI Contact Centre: Mon–Sat 9:30 AM – 6:00 PM

name: PM Vishwakarma Portal (CSC Biometric Registration)
headquarters: New Delhi — Ministry of Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises
overview: Official portal for 18 traditional artisan & craftsperson trades offering PM Vishwakarma Certificate, ₹15,000 toolkit e-voucher, skill stipend, and 5% concessional collateral-free loans.
processing_time: 3-tier Gram Panchayat/ULB + District + Bank verification (~15–21 days)
collateral_policy: 100% collateral-free (Tranche 1: ₹1 lakh; Tranche 2: ₹2 lakh) at capped 5% p.a. interest rate.
bank_required_documents: Aadhaar Card (with biometric e-KYC at CSC)

name: State Government Single-Window Credit & Subsidy Portals
overview: Official State Government portals for state-specific interest subvention, margin money grants, youth self-employment, and SC/ST/OBC/Women entrepreneurship schemes.
processing_time: 15–30 working days via District Industries Centre (DIC) / Social Welfare
collateral_policy: State subsidy/subvention applied after bank sanction as per state scheme guidelines.
helpline_hours: 24x7 Online Portal • State Helpline: Mon–Fri 10:00 AM – 5:00 PM
